title: /integrations/dremel_3d_printer
description: Instructions on how to integrate a Dremel 3D Printer into Home Assistant.
body: The [Dremel 3D Printer](https://www.dremel.com/gn/en/digilab)  allows you to monitor your Dremel 3D printer and its progress with your Home Assistant installation. This integration is currently limited to the 3D20, 3D40 and 3D45.
